simple.meaning: מְאוּרָה (mᵉʼûwrâh) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “something lighted , i.e. an aperture ; by implication, a crevice or hole (of a serpent).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
